title: Logifex Protocol Plugin Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a Logifex Protocol plugin (plugin.json). Shipped for editor/IDE tooling; @logifex-protocol/plugin's validator enforces the same rules in TypeScript, so this file need not be executed at validation time.

name.description: An npm-style package name, optionally scoped.

type.description: Fixed. A Theme or Template manifest is a different shape with its own schema, not a variant of this one.

category.description: Ecosystem taxonomy, not protocol correctness. Optional.

core.description: A semver range this plugin is compatible with, e.g. ^0.2.0.

permissions.description: Capabilities this plugin needs. Declared, not runtime-enforced in v1.

provides.description: Capabilities this plugin offers. Not yet a Capability Contract (no guarantees attached) — just an advertised name.

extensionPoints.description: Named points in Core/host app this plugin attaches to. Required; an empty array means a standalone/general-purpose plugin. A missing field is invalid — ambiguity here would weaken the one mechanically-verifiable boundary this field exists to provide.

entry.description: Relative path to the compiled entry point.
